title: GTA 6 Preload Goes Live as Fans Dig Into Data for Unannounced Info
description: GTA 6 preloads are officially live for players in New Zealand and those pretending to be, with fans now scanning game files for unannounced information.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Preloads Go Live: Fans Begin Scanning Files for Hidden Secrets

As anticipation reaches an all-time high, the excitement surrounding *Grand Theft Auto VI* has taken a new turn. According to reports from IGN Games, GTA 6 preloads are now officially live. Players residing in New Zealand—as well as resourceful fans simulating a New Zealand location to get a head start—are currently able to download the game files.

However, downloading the game is only the first step for the most dedicated segment of the community. The moment the preload became available, fans and data-focused enthusiasts immediately began scanning the game files. The primary goal of this data-digging effort is to unearth any unannounced information, hidden clues, or unexpected details that might be lingering within the downloaded data packages ahead of the official launch.

## The Data Mining Phenomenon Ahead of Launch

It has become commonplace in the modern gaming landscape for preloads to spark intense data mining campaigns. Eager fans frequently comb through game directories, texture files, and text strings in hopes of discovering maps, vehicle lineups, or reference points that developers have yet to officially reveal.

At this stage, any findings derived from scanning these preloaded files remain purely speculative and unconfirmed by official sources. Publishers routinely implement heavy encryption and compartmentalization on preloads, meaning that any bits and pieces uncovered by the community should be approached with caution.

## Editor's Take

The launch of the GTA 6 preload marks another major milestone on the road to release. While data mining offers an exciting glimpse into the technical side of the hype, players should temper their expectations regarding unverified leaks and preserve the magic of discovery for day one.
